If Wi-Fi will not connect, first check that the router is on, the network name and password are correct, and the device supports the network band. Then check signal strength.
A BPU model may fail to load because an ION memory pool is insufficient. Inspect the actual exit code and allocation log rather than relying only on available system RAM.
An embedding model converts text or images into vectors for semantic retrieval. It does not generate conversational answers.
Query and document vectors must share the same dimension. Use the appropriate task prefixes and normalization. Cosine similarity is not the probability that an answer is correct.
Processing six images together can amortize model-loading costs, but time per image derived from batch throughput is not single-request response latency.
